name: mmdrome
subtitle: Self-hosted music player releases
description: SideStore source for mmdrome — install and update without manual sideloading. SideStore signs the app with your own Apple ID and refreshes it automatically.

apps.name: mmdrome
apps.subtitle: Minimalist music player for Navidrome / WebDAV
apps.localizedDescription: Self-hosted, mobile-first music player. Streams from Navidrome, writes ratings back via WebDAV, works in the iOS background.
apps.versionDescription: Seeking into a streaming track that has not loaded yet now keeps your position instead of restarting at 0:00, and a far seek on a transcoded track starts from an offset stream so audio arrives sooner. Prefetch now yields to your own transfers, and seeks log their latency for diagnostics.

versions.localizedDescription: Seeking into a streaming track that has not loaded yet now keeps your position instead of restarting at 0:00, and a far seek on a transcoded track starts from an offset stream so audio arrives sooner. Prefetch now yields to your own transfers, and seeks log their latency for diagnostics.
Applying a filter or sort to the queue now continues from the current track instead of restarting at the top of the sort order.
Fixes a crash when dragging rows in the queue, and adds a 'Recently added' library sort.

Recovery and streaming reliability: the audio engine rebuilds after an invalidated audio session instead of dying until relaunch (with a tap-to-restart banner); prefetch retries use the classified ladder and carry response fingerprints; and transcode streams start as soon as the file is readable.

Native stream recovery: an active transcode now continues in place through a hard transport cut instead of restarting from 0:00, and a Range answer that is not an aligned 206 (including a mismatched or missing Content-Range) is rejected to a fresh download rather than spliced. Active-load retry ownership is now exclusive and environmental — foreground failures go to the JS ladder, background to the native retry, so a foreground yield immediately followed by backgrounding waits for foreground to resume. The stream self-test now gathers server facts from unloaded tracks, so it no longer needs playback stopped, and reports continuation recovery and Range-answer alignment. Maturation staging deliberately stays with the loader because it is fed by the loader's byte ledgers. NativeAudioEngine remains ~3,548 lines as a known, not-yet-addressed size debt. The in-loader hard-error continuation and its 206 alignment check are compile- and unit-verified only; device verification is intended on this SideStore build.

Defer the stream self-test probe while a transcode is live, recover partial transcodes on writer error, attribute transfer cuts (churn vs stable path) and branch the native retry ladder on that verdict, surface the observed retry-branch counters in the Debug HUD, and let its Clear-all button reset them for a fresh observation window.
The stream self-test now folds the promote verdict (it is logged on the loader domain) and treats a 206 as Range proof, so its checks populate instead of reading unknown.
The stream self-test now captures a running stream's events (its look-back was reading the wrong clock), so its verdicts populate instead of all reading unknown.

Transcode playback now streams while downloading instead of waiting for the full file, with a one-button in-app stream self-test; native prefetch retry recovery, park-and-drain, and a network-churn latch that stops metered flapping.

Queue sort fixes: flipping the sort direction now visibly re-ranks the auto queue, an explicit sort change shows the new order from the top, the queue's sort editor is a distinct card, and the library sort menu stays open so you can flip directions live.
The auto queue keeps its own persisted sort (hidden while shuffle is on), and the FilterSortBar gains an apply-to-auto-queue button - visible only when settings differ - behind a confirm popup.

Queue fixes: row taps play the right song again, the now-playing indicator is back, drag to reorder works, scrolling no longer slides, and jump-to-current works from anywhere in the queue. The empty now-playing island opens the player too.

Thumbnail fast paths: covers snap in instantly with no fade, cached regions load at decode speed, and every virtualized surface now keeps two screens of off-screen buffer so slow scrolls find covers already loaded.

Virtualized scrolling across every library surface: Songs, the Albums and Artists grids with their detail lists, and the Queue now render fixed windows, which fixes scroll jank and makes covers load instantly on large libraries. Also smoother queue re-anchoring on repeat plays.
Relink orphaned pending edits after Navidrome id migrations; Push names every track and can discard edits; smarter file re-binding.

Node-truth completion evidence: the completion gates judge the completing node's own consumed-frame position (.dataPlayedBack + in-callback playerTime capture) instead of the epsilon-tolerated wall clock; the 2.0 s near-end epsilon remains defense-in-depth for the wall fallback only. Danger lines carry nodeElapsed=/evidence= provenance.

Near-end mid-fade crossfade finalize: a byte-complete track whose active-node EOF lands within 2 s of the segment end now finalizes the switch instead of aborting the fade into the D1 dead-air advance (the 18:41Z restart / 18:51Z skip dumps); abort-keep-active stays for genuinely short bytes

Early-close network fingerprint: every stream early-close log now carries the response status and connection headers (Connection, Content-Length, Content-Range, Accept-Ranges, Content-Type) so the next dump can definitively confirm or rule out Wi-Fi data assist as the close cause

Disk-truth continuation + verdict for early-closed streams (the repeatedly-skipping dump): the writer's byte counter is per-byte truth, the continuation Range-resumes from the FILE's end, and a complete-on-disk file can never again be destroyed by a counter mismatch; evict teardown close-ownership (BUG G twin)

In-loader Range continuation for early-closed staged streams (the crossfade stop cycling at 0-1s); native active-load retry with long-haul kick for backgrounded failures (33-min dead air); artwork failure backoff; maturation monotonicity; phantom resume prune; D1 watchdog covers staged-complete tracks

Scroll-jank and thumbnail fixes: song rows render ratings conditionally, view-state persistence is debounced off the scroll path, stable queue keys end the DOM churn behind thumbnails-not-loading, blur only where genuinely upscaled, cellular-flap hysteresis, and a COVERS diagnostics section in the debug HUD; LDM thumbnails step down except Now Playing art

Transcode completeness gate: a socket-cut transcode can no longer enter the cache as complete and kill crossfade standbys (root cause of the crossfade-then-stop aborts); dead-air watchdog recovery from 1.2.34 remains as defense-in-depth
Dead-air watchdog: crossfade-then-stop wedge fixed — a playing track whose clock runs past its scheduled end now advances instead of sitting in silence; abort logs carry elapsed evidence

Navidrome 0.64.1 migration readiness: version-gated library cache (one full re-sync after a server upgrade — dead-id protection), required cover-art size with blurred micro-rendition placeholders, auth-health ledger stops the invalid-credential request spam (0.64.1 rate-limits failed logins), stale-ID queue/metadata reconcile pins, plus the streaming field-dump fixes (staged play race, swallowed completions, stall rescue, seekbar progress for streamed tracks).

Native streaming: audio starts before the download finishes. Crossfade works on streamed tracks once files complete. Resumable downloads on shaky connections. New debug fields (stagedActive/Complete/Stalled/FadeEligible) and stream/maturation event domains in the dump.

Truncation defense completed: byte-exact Content-Length gate for clean early closes (Connectivity Assist churn), finalize re-entrancy fix (crossfaded track restarts), bounded prefetch retry with backoff, version-gated iOS opus verdict (LDM transcodes to opus again), stale-clock crossfade guard, and a finalize re-entry completion drop. Web: live debug-HUD toggle, full event rings in the dump, honest retire discrimination, native format-probe bypass.

P0 fixes from the first field dump: the crossfade finalize path is now gated by the truncation check (a truncated active file can no longer switch tracks with its tail missing), and refreshQueue reconciles lagging snapshots instead of stopping live playback (the divergence stop-storm). Adds the backward-advance field detector, ring hygiene (network transitions only, artwork-guard drops to info), live debug-HUD toggle without page reload, full event rings in Copy dumps, and a native format-probe bypass fixing the false aac unsupported verdict.
Structured event log (native + web at parity) for full Copy-dump diagnosability; fixed the 1.2.28 crossfade wedge and same-track loop; observe-only web truncation gate; loop-one restart bound
LDM multi-skip fix: truncated preload downloads are rejected and re-fetched; crossfade standby mid-fade abort keeps the queue alive; HUD Last.fm session indicator fixed

Two-lane thumbnail landing: the far-scroll 5s was a self-caused server flood (tier lane empties the screen before the band trickle starts); cached revisits arm instantly, ending pop-in; the stability gate closes the scrollbar firehose outright.

Thumbnail lead time doubled and widened to cover the whole screen during scrolls - fresh territory starts loading sooner, placeholders at the screen edges are gone, and scrolling back is instant since fetched covers stay alive in a wider window. Cached covers remain instant. Verified across songs, albums, artists, and 550-row queues.

Covers are requested by content hash, so Navidrome serves them with immutable year-long caching - revisiting thumbnails no longer waits on revalidation, even across restarts. A flick stopped by a tap loads the landing screen immediately instead of waiting out the scroll gate. Low data mode no longer re-downloads thumbnails already on screen; the smaller size applies the next time the row loads. Verified across songs, albums, artists, and 550-row queues.

Thumbnail pipeline: paced mid-gesture arming and far-cover unlatching fix the scrollbar-jump stalls and the +5s landing loads from 1.2.23. Covers now load at every scroll speed on every view - songs, albums, artists grids, and long queues (verified to 550 rows). Slow drags paint the reading position live; flown-past fetches abort and free memory; scrolled-back covers re-arm instantly.

Chunked Albums/Artists grids (50-cell render windows with IO sentinel growth — 5,000-cell libraries mount 50 cells, not 5,000); thumbnail velocity gate without the mount warmup; session-stable Subsonic salt so cover URLs (and their HTTP-cache revalidation) survive restarts.
Keychain-backed credential storage on iOS
Multi-skip fix (completion cascade + trust-boundary validation); non-blocking Debug HUD; credential-safe Copy dump
Bridge trail in Debug HUD — one command/event timeline across the bridge to diagnose the multi-skip jump
Crash breadcrumb in Debug HUD (no more .ips needed); compile-time guard on engine starts; e2e failure diagnostics
Native robustness: guarded engine starts on every resume/fade path, preload window re-derives on crossfade toggle, deferred-arm fixes for paused window growth
Native preload: chain re-arm after queue refresh; played-row tint kept; diff baseline fixed
EQ: classic preset switch (apply + confirm), manual vertical zoom + pinch
Fix play crash: spectrum tap wired in-line, play() guards engine start
Fix 1.2.13 launch crash: spectrum tap attached before connect
EQ spectrum overlay: live audio behind the curve while music plays, so you can see which frequencies to target; plus a one-line hint under the preset select while edits are unsaved
EQ: Save as Current works after preset switches (continuous session rebasing); all dialogs centered on phones; preset switching no longer discards or force-saves edits
EQ graph: pan & zoom the frequency axis, easy-to-press dots, dialogs are proper modals now
EQ redesign: unified Save with overwrite/new-preset choice, curve-snapped graph dots with tap editors, add-band frequency prompt, per-band settings
Album/artist covers load ahead of your scroll: wider pre-roll, faster thumbnail pipeline
Slider knobs mark the exact value with a lighter track; Art/Lyrics button only appears for songs that have lyrics
Preload indicators: engine-derived window — every upcoming row now lights reliably, and the current track's seek-bar layer appears even when served from cache
Instant preload indicators: downloads light up the moment they finish, seekbar loaded layer on fast servers; search clear buttons
Slider usability: press-to-jump accent sliders everywhere; preload indicators now light up on fast servers; lyrics art backdrop + timestamps
Navidrome lyrics: synced highlight, tap-to-seek, cached with negative TTL
EQ overhaul: persistent working state, editable graph, flexible bands with per-point curve modes; slider visuals fixed on all platforms
Sequential native preloading, honest load indicators, native seek-bar loaded layer, cover fallback ladder — five playback-surface fixes.
Smoother seek dragging, correct advance after queue reorder, stable auto-queue order, native preload indicators, queue layout fixes
Finalized UI design: accent-marks-states system, whole-row now-playing treatment, rectangular seek bar, compact queue island, scroll-to-top on all long lists
Low-data transcoding fixes, live data-saver status, undecodable-track skip
File Matching redesign: attention buckets, Confirm-this-is-correct, row search and filters. iOS Audio Mixing mode (play alongside other apps).
